name: Residente Permanente

requirements.blocker_text: Requires having enjoyed temporary residence for 3 consecutive years (extends to the holder's spouse and first-degree blood relatives).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 consecutive years of temporary residence.

requirement_groups.name: First-degree blood relative of a Costa Rican citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a first-degree blood relationship (parent, child -- with or without disability --, or minor/disabled sibling) with a Costa Rican citizen.

requirement_groups.name: Restricted Visas and Refugee Commission grant

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a discretionary grant by Costa Rica's Restricted Visas and Refugee Commission.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 3 consecutive years of temporary residence, OR proof of first-degree family tie to a Costa Rican citizen
Continuous CCSS (social security) insurance from the time residency is granted

outcome.duration_length: indefinite (subject to maintaining continuous CCSS insurance)

sources.title: Defensoría de los Habitantes de la República (dhr.go.cr) -- Ley General de Migración y Extranjería No. 8764, Título VI, Article 78

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Costa Rica's initial build. Three genuinely different OR-logic groups model this SAME 'Residente Permanente' status, per Article 78: (1) 3 years on any qualifying temporary residence, extending to spouse and first-degree relatives; (2) a direct first-degree blood tie to a Costa Rican citizen, with no residence-duration test of its own; (3) a discretionary Commission grant (this third group covers, among others, certain recognised refugees). A continuing CCSS (Caja Costarricense de Seguro Social) insurance requirement applies throughout, confirmed directly at tier-1 -- an unusual, worth-flagging ongoing condition beyond the initial qualifying test.
